"""TableSync prototype: track tables, waitlist, and estimated wait time."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from statistics import mean
import time

@dataclass
class Table:
    name: str
    seats: int
    occupied_since: float | None = None
    turnover_minutes: list = field(default_factory=lambda: [60.0])

@dataclass
class Party:
    name: str
    size: int
    arrived: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

class TableSync:
    def __init__(self, tables):
        self.tables = tables
        self.waitlist: list[Party] = []

    def free_tables_for(self, size):
        return [t for t in self.tables if t.occupied_since is None and t.seats >= size]

    def add_party(self, party):
        free = self.free_tables_for(party.size)
        if free:
            t = min(free, key=lambda t: t.seats)  # best fit
            t.occupied_since = time.time()
            return f"seated {party.name} at {t.name}"
        self.waitlist.append(party)
        return f"waitlisted {party.name} (position {len(self.waitlist)}, ~{self.estimate_wait(party.size)} min)"

    def clear_table(self, name, now=None):
        now = now or time.time()
        t = next(t for t in self.tables if t.name == name)
        if t.occupied_since is not None:
            t.turnover_minutes.append((now - t.occupied_since) / 60)
        t.occupied_since = None
        for i, p in enumerate(self.waitlist):
            if t.seats >= p.size:
                self.waitlist.pop(i)
                t.occupied_since = now
                return f"seated {p.name} at {t.name} from waitlist"
        return f"{t.name} is free"

    def estimate_wait(self, size):
        eligible = [t for t in self.tables if t.seats >= size]
        if not eligible:
            return None
        avg = mean(m for t in eligible for m in t.turnover_minutes)
        ahead = sum(1 for p in self.waitlist if p.size <= max(t.seats for t in eligible))
        return round(avg * (ahead + 1) / len(eligible))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ts = TableSync([Table("T1", 2), Table("T2", 4), Table("T3", 6)])
    print(ts.add_party(Party("Garcia", 4)))
    print(ts.add_party(Party("Lee", 2)))
    print(ts.add_party(Party("Nguyen", 6)))
    print(ts.add_party(Party("Patel", 4)))
    print(ts.clear_table("T2"))
EOF

import time

    seats: int
    occupied_since: float | None = None
    turnover_minutes: list = field(default_factory=lambda: [60.0])

@dataclass
class Party:
    name: str
    size: int
    arrived: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

class TableSync:
    def __init__(self, tables):
        self.tables = tables
        self.waitlist: list[Party] = []

    def free_tables_for(self, size):
        return [t for t in self.tables if t.occupied_since is None and t.seats >= size]

    def add_party(self, party):
        free = self.free_tables_for(party.size)
        if free:
            t = min(free, key=lambda t: t.seats)  # best fit
            t.occupied_since = time.time()
            return f"seated {party.name} at {t.name}"
        self.waitlist.append(party)
        return f"waitlisted {party.name} (position {len(self.waitlist)}, ~{self.estimate_wait(party.size)} min)"

    def clear_table(self, name, now=None):
        now = now or time.time()
        t = next(t for t in self.tables if t.name == name)

        t.occupied_since = None
        for i, p in enumerate(self.waitlist):

                return f"seated {p.name} at {t.name} from waitlist"

"""Order-entry flow per plan_pos_v1: order per table, tap items, send to station printers, split payments."""
from orders import Item, Order

MENU = {
    "burger": Item("burger", 12.0, "grill"),
    "fries": Item("fries", 4.0, "grill"),
    "beer": Item("beer", 6.0, "bar"),
    "soda": Item("soda", 2.5, "bar"),
}

def add(order, key, mods=None):
    base = MENU[key]
    it = Item(base.name, base.price, base.station, list(mods or []))
    order.items.append(it)
    return it

def tickets(order):
    """Group items by station so each printer gets one ticket."""
    out = {}
    for i in order.items:
        out.setdefault(i.station, []).append(i.name + (f" ({', '.join(i.modifiers)})" if i.modifiers else ""))
    return out

if __name__ == "__main__":
    o = Order("T4")
    add(o, "burger", ["no onion"]); add(o, "fries"); add(o, "beer")
    print(tickets(o))
    print("total", o.total())
    o.pay(10.0)
